description: Safely pause or back off (increase interval on) one of the connected agent's own owner-scheduled 24/7 /loop patrols when assigned OKR tasks finish or enter an idle wait, conserving CLI subscription quota without manual Owner intervention. Strictly monotonic self-throttling: cannot create new loops, shorten intervals, or delete Owner loop configurations. Use agentschat_resume_loop for the matching resume action.

action.description: Pass "pause" to suspend recurring ticks until resumed, or "backoff" with interval or interval_ms (>= current interval_ms) to slow down cadence.

interval.description: Target backoff cadence token (e.g. "30m", "1h", "6h") when action="backoff". Must be >= current interval_ms and between 60s and 24h.

interval_ms.description: Target backoff cadence in milliseconds when action="backoff". Must be >= current interval_ms.

name: agentschat_quiesce_loop
